product_summary: Bangalore (Karnataka) manufacturer of wire-drawing dies and cable-extrusion tooling (mikrotek.in, ISO 9001:2015, est. 1993). Real catalogue lines: (1) natural diamond dies 0.010–1.500 mm; (2) polycrystalline (PCD) and SMP dies; (3) synthetic single-crystal diamond dies; (4) solid enameling dies; (5) tungsten-carbide (TC) drawing dies and TC taper inserts 0.500–15 mm, DIN/ISO nibs from Kennametal/Sandvik Hyperion; (6) Mikrotek Nano dies; (7) bunching/stranding/compacting dies; (8) extrusion tools for cable industry — cross heads (single/dual/triple insulation, manual and fixed centre, cable 4–175 mm), distributors, extrusion tips (tool steel, TC, carbide/diamond inserts), extrusion dies, allied tools (bypass connections, breaker plates, sector rollers); (9) diamond die working equipment — wire polishing machines WPF1S/WPA/WPAB (0.010–30 mm) and ultrasonic die polishing machines USBNG 250/300, USMBT 250/300/500; (10) TC die working equipment; (11) die inspection equipment; (12) consumables (diamond powders); (13) services — die reconditioning/repolishing, turnkey projects, machine installation and maintenance.
comment: HS 820790 ('other interchangeable tools for hand tools, whether or not power-operated') is only partially right. The core product — wire-drawing dies (diamond, PCD, TC) and TC taper inserts — is HS 8207 20 (dies for drawing or extruding metal), which is the correct primary code and is missing from the declaration. 820790 covers only the residual tooling (extrusion tips, some allied tools). The declared single code also fails to capture three other real product families: (a) cable-extrusion cross heads, distributors, extrusion dies and breaker plates — plastics/rubber processing machinery parts, HS 8480 79 (moulds for rubber or plastics, other) or 8477 90 as parts of extruders, depending on whether supplied as complete heads or spares; (b) die working / polishing / inspection machines (WPF, WPA, WPAB, USBNG, USMBT) — machine tools for polishing/grinding, HS 8460 90 (other grinding/polishing machines) or 8462/8466 parts; (c) diamond powders/consumables — HS 7105 10 or 3405 depending on form. Industry label 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is a misclassification: the company is a precision tooling / machine-building supplier to the wire & cable industry, not a metals producer or miner. No trader signs — own manufacturing facility, own proprietary 'Solid Rock Technology', own machine models, own brand; classified as manufacturer. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company retained, code corrected to 820720 as primary with 820790, 848079, 846090 as secondary lines. All product lines above are taken from the company's own website pages (mikrotek.in home, /natural-diamond-dies/, /tc-drawing-dies-and-taper-inserts/, /extrusion-tools/, /diamond-die-working-equipment/); no customs line or shipment record was checked in this pass, therefore the product range is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level. Revenue, export volume, PAN, CIN and state registration data were not researched per role scope — null.
